# TEST FIXTURE ONLY: not the editorial method

This stands in for the real method in automated tests. The real
"Short story editorial method and checklist.md" goes in content/.

## Stages
0. Brief. 1. Cold read. 2. Design statement. 3. Scene map. 4. Genre layer.
5. Register layer. 6. Line pass. 7. Triage. 8. Letter.

## Checklist
M8. In comic or deadpan stories, ask whether an oddity is the joke.
